messages.subject: Project Meridian - completed
messages.plaintextBody:
Helena, Naomi,

Delighted to confirm that the Master SaaS Subscription Agreement with Sentvia was executed and exchanged this afternoon. A PDF of the executed agreement is attached for your records, along with our completion checklist and signature pack. The agreed terms reflect everything we set out to secure - the 125%/150% liability architecture, 24-hour breach notification, the data-export right and the 5% uplift cap.

Congratulations on getting this over the line. We'll send our final invoice in due course.

Kind regards,
James Osei
Senior Associate | Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ | +44 (0)20 7946 0112

Confidential and may be legally privileged.
